note: sensitivity now uses a local exact refinement around the FC boundary.
      First a global calibration belt is built once, then each outer toy
      re-calibrates only the boundary-neighbour BR points with toy-specific
      nested FC toys. validation compares this local-exact method against
      the slower full nested toy construction.
